description:
Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)

Goal
- Reduce “time-to-ready” for new Dedicated and shared GPU capacity by automating provisioning, standardizing golden images, and enforcing validated configuration gates.
- Make fleet bring-up repeatable across regions and GPU types while minimizing manual intervention and post-provision break/fix.

Scope (in-sprint)
- Image pipeline: build/version GPU node images (drivers, CUDA, NCCL, kubelet/containerd config, security hardening) with provenance and rollback.
- Provisioning automation: turn GPU instances from “allocated” -> “joined cluster” -> “ready for inference workloads” with orchestration steps and retries.
- Validation gates: pre-flight + post-flight checks (GPU health, driver/toolkit parity, networking, storage, runtime smoke test, perf canary) that must pass before a node is marked Ready.
- Control-plane integration: surface node readiness state and failure reasons to platform/fleet tooling; emit metrics and logs for triage.
- Observability + SLOs: dashboards/alerts for provision-to-ready P50/P95, failure rates by step, and top failure modes.
- Rollout: staged rollout by region and GPU type with feature flags and clear rollback plan.

Out of scope (deferred)
- Major scheduler changes, new cluster architectures, or large-scale region expansions.
- Customer-facing UX work beyond exposing readiness status and basic failure reason fields.

Key stakeholders
- Infra/Fleet: Vanessa Ortiz (EM), Keiko Yamamoto, Jamal Pierce, Nina Petrova, Harish Reddy
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (Dir), Rafael Mendes (Mgr), Miles Thornton, Aisha Bello
- Platform Control Plane: Priya Natarajan (VP), Ethan Park (EM), Benji Okafor, Jordan Lee
- Release Engineering: Connor O’Brien, Sahana Iyer
- Security/Compliance (consulted): Fiona McCarthy (SecOps) + security team for image hardening and access controls

Timeline (hypothetical)
- Week 1: baseline measurement + design/ADRs + validation checklist + initial image pipeline draft
- Weeks 2–3: implement orchestration steps + readiness API/state machine + first validations + dashboards
- Week 4: staged rollout (one region/GPU type), incident drills, hardening, and doc/runbook completion

Primary deliverables
- Golden image build and versioning process (including rollback)
- Automated provision-to-ready workflow with gating checks
- Readiness state model + metrics + dashboards + alerts
- Runbooks and on-call playbooks for common failure modes
- PRs implementing pipeline/config/observability changes, plus tickets tracking rollout and follow-ups
